caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated object that resembles a tooth or tusk, colored in shades of light beige and cream with natural-looking striations and shading. On the surface of this object, there is a fine line illustration of a human skeleton holding a curved blade above its head with one hand, while its body is positioned in a diagonal, almost dancing pose. The background is plain, off-white paper, and there are no additional objects present in the image. Handwritten text at the bottom right reads "full size C. Ward."
title: Scrimshaw
